versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the *loadpage* skill (version 1.0.0).
- Provides text humanization capabilities using the comprehensive AI-writing pattern removal workflow described in SKILL.md.
- Detects and fixes common AI writing traits, such as exaggerated symbolism, promotional phrasing, vague attributions, and superficial "-ing" analyses.
- Adds guidance for improving tonal variety and injecting personality to make text more natural and human-like.
